Preserve exact adult woman's sharp alert face, compact lean athletic build, partially gathered dark hair with loose shorter strands, asymmetrical worn light traveling cape/scarf, layered dark practical tunic and loose trousers, rope belt with small charm, forearm/shin wraps and travel sandals. She wields TWO short tantō daggers, ONE in each hand, same short blades as reference; never long swords. Light wary survival footwork, quick compact motions, cape asymmetric and functional.
Exactly EIGHT FULL-BODY separate cels in TWO COLUMNS FOUR ROWS on PORTRAIT canvas, reading order. Every figure facing RIGHT in consistent side/three-quarter game camera. Same body and face scale, weapon length, anatomy and costume across all drawings. True TRANSPARENT background, clean monochrome detailed ink matching master, opaque white skin and cloth. Each complete figure including hair, dagger tips and feet enclosed in its own cel, with generous clear empty gutters. No overlapping cels. No text, grid, labels, backdrop, ground, shadows, effects, motion blur, extra weapons or limbs.

Low restrained steps; gaze ahead, shoulders ready, both knives maintained close and safe. Show actual sequential limb poses and subtle cape/hair follow-through, not repeated translated drawings.
